about: Synthetic reference squads: invented players, calibrated on the FM27 player database. Not real players.

calibration.source: Premier League clubs at the start of the season; lower English leagues (tiers 2-5, middle eight each) from a second save at the start of the season

distance_check.measure: Euclidean distance to the nearest real player in the database over all 52 attributes on the 1-20 scale; it must exceed the position group's threshold, the 5th percentile of real players' distance to their nearest other real player (ratio above 1 = farther than that)
